Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Blue
Colors: Blue
Materials: wool
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported The cool tones of this bold, geometric rug pulls any space together effortlessly. Hand-woven, 100% wool fibers add lasting style and comfort. Area rug features a mesmerizing geometric print. Hand-tufted. Low .3'' pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas. Pair with a rug pad (sold separately). 4' x 6' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag.
